claims.statement: Moderation then Blocked users is a sidebar navigation path. This does not identify blocked people, verify moderation authority, establish effective restrictions, or authorize blocking.

Blocking may be indefinite or time-limited. A timed block automatically ends at the selected expiry, while an indefinite block may be manually removed at any time. The fragment supplies no concrete duration, actual expiry receipt, or verified unblock operation; the linked procedure is not reviewed by reference.

The Teams-page screenshot caption describes an outlined bulk-selection dropdown showing two selected teams. This is a caption-only reference, not image inspection, actual team selection, a minimum/maximum bulk limit, or proof of an edit.

The team Members-page screenshot caption describes an outlined dropdown with two selected members. This is not an inspected image, live membership census, selection limit, completed membership change, or authority to edit.

Requiring members to use SSH certificates for organization resources is a supported option, with a GHES-specific exception when SSH is disabled in the repository. This is neither a universal requirement to enable SSH nor proof of native certificate enforcement, applicability outside the containing product context, or any performed credential change.

Only the FPT/GHEC branch states that an invitation can be edited or cancelled before the invitee accepts. The pre-acceptance boundary does not authorize removing accepted membership or establish that the same procedure is available on GHES; the linked guide is not reviewed by reference.
